summary.text: R. Tyler MacAllister is the Republican nominee for Massachusetts's 9th District and will face Rep. Bill Keating in the November general election. He serves on the Mattapoisett Select Board and owns a charter fishing business. He had not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey; his campaign website has solutions and ballot-question pages.

paragraphs.text: MacAllister was born in Massachusetts; a 2021 report says he is originally from Cape Cod and has lived in Mattapoisett with his family for about 20 years.
According to the same report, he holds a bachelor's degree in marine biology from UMass Dartmouth and an MBA from UMass.
He owns a charter fishing business and has worked as a consultant to the renewable energy industry.
MacAllister served eight years on the Mattapoisett Select Board, left to apply for town administrator, and lost a close race to return to the board.
He later held a five-year seat on the Conservation Commission and served on the Plymouth County Advisory Board and the town Finance Committee.
In a July 2021 special election to fill the unexpired term of a member who had died, he won a Select Board seat, 471 votes to 224, and in May 2023 he was reelected to a three-year term.
Ballotpedia lists him as serving on the Mattapoisett Select Board as of 2026, while August 2026 news reports describe him as a former board member.
